summary.name: Tunnelblick
summary.one_liner: Tunnelblick is a free, open-source graphical user interface for OpenVPN on macOS, and this page is its download page with verification instructions.
use_cases: Connect to OpenVPN servers from a Mac
Verify the integrity of a downloaded Tunnelblick disk image
Install Tunnelblick without macOS phoning home to Apple
Get beta or stable Tunnelblick releases
summary.what_it_does: The page lists Tunnelblick release downloads and explains how to verify them. It describes checking SHA256, SHA1 and MD5 hashes with the macOS shasum tool, and verifying GnuPG signatures with a published Tunnelblick public key. It explains that updates via the built-in updater use HTTPS and digital signatures. It also gives Terminal steps for downloading the .dmg with curl to avoid the macOS quarantine flag, and notes the trade-off of disabling macOS notarization checks. The page states that Tunnelblick is Free Software with no ads, tracking or IP logs, and that it bundles OpenVPN, OpenSSL, easy-rsa and drivers. It also hosts user-contributed scripts that are not endorsed by the project and run as root.
notable: Free, open-source OpenVPN GUI that bundles OpenVPN, OpenSSL, easy-rsa and drivers
Publishes SHA256, SHA1 and MD5 hashes and GnuPG signatures for each download
Includes Terminal instructions to download without macOS quarantine flag
caveats: Bypassing the quarantine flag disables macOS notarization and malware security checks
User-contributed scripts are not endorsed or checked by the project and run as root
Downloads were hosted on SourceForge from 2013 to 2015 before moving to GitHub; the page notes GitHub redirects for some downloads
